name: Matrix Transformation Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit inequality/forbidden product list with a 2D rotation-scaling matrix transformation. The condition requires that the 4th power of the matrix applied to a basis vector does not lie on the x-axis. Mathematically, this evaluates to the imaginary part of (s_u + i s_v)^4 being non-zero, which simplifies to s_u != s_v. This prevents LLMs from immediately recognizing the problem as Graph 3-Coloring, thereby bypassing their optimized DSATUR/degree-sorting heuristics and forcing naive backtracking to time out.
